units.source_text: 我坐在昏暗的餐桌旁，因寒冷而渾身打戰，

en.t: I sat by the dim dining table, shivering all over from the cold,

units.source_text: 一點一點地把飯菜塞進嘴裡，不由地在心中暗暗想：

en.t: and little by little stuffed the food into my mouth, unable to keep myself from secretly thinking:

units.source_text: 人為什麼每天非得吃三餐不可呢？

en.t: Why do people absolutely have to eat three meals every day?

units.source_text: 每個人用餐時都板著臉，彷彿在履行某種儀式。

en.t: Everyone wore a stiff expression at meals, as if carrying out some kind of ritual.

units.source_text: 全家老小一日三餐，在規定的時刻聚集在昏暗的房間裡，

en.t: Three times a day, the whole family, young and old, gathered at the appointed hour in the dim room,

units.source_text: 井然有序地擺好飯菜，不論是否想吃，都會低著頭一聲不吭地嚼著飯粒，

en.t: set out the food in perfect order, and whether they wanted to eat or not, lowered their heads and chewed their rice without a word,

units.source_text: 彷彿是向潛伏於家中的亡靈進行祈禱的一種儀式。

en.t: as if it were a ritual of prayer offered to the dead spirits lurking in the house.

units.source_text: 「人不吃飯就會死」這句話在我聽來，

en.t: To my ears, the saying, "People will die if they do not eat,"

units.source_text: 無異於一種討厭的恐嚇。

en.t: was nothing other than an unpleasant threat.
